extras: Supports template variables {{title}}, {{date}}, and {{time}} that are replaced when a resource is created; new and renamed template properties are synced to existing resources.
intentEvidence: creating dynamic templates for your notes
problem: Obsidian's built-in templates copy content once but do not keep properties linked to the template or present them as an editable infobox.
summary: Template-based resource creator that generates notes inheriting template properties and showing a wiki-style infobox.
